title: Nvidia stock drops as board debates CEO’s future
dek: Investors pushed Nvidia down about 6% after the company’s board met to discuss whether to remove CEO Jensen Huang.
body:
Nvidia shares fell roughly 6% after the company’s board met to consider whether to remove Jensen Huang as CEO (chief executive officer). The meeting took place on Wednesday and left investors waiting for a clear outcome.

## Why it matters

Nvidia is a major technology company with substantial influence on chip markets and investor portfolios. A board discussion about removing the CEO introduces leadership uncertainty that can affect stock price, employee morale, partnerships and longer-term strategy. The market’s roughly 6% reaction shows investors are pricing in the risk of near-term disruption while they await the board’s decision.

## The details

- Nvidia’s board met on Wednesday to discuss whether to oust Jensen Huang as CEO.
- Nvidia stock fell about 6% as investors reacted to the meeting.
- The company has not provided additional public details about the board’s deliberations or any decision.
- The timing of any final decision, whether any other board actions occurred, and any statements from Nvidia or Jensen Huang were not disclosed in the available report.

## What to watch

Look for an official statement from Nvidia’s board or from Jensen Huang that clarifies whether a leadership change will happen and on what timetable. Investors will also watch Nvidia’s filings and trading updates for concrete details about any board resolution or interim leadership arrangements.

Source: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-nvda-jensen-huang-second-affair.html)
